kicker: DeepSeek DSec: the agent sandbox fleet

scenes.headline: How DeepSeek runs agents by the million
scenes.sub: The sandbox fleet behind its agentic reinforcement learning.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dmitri! DeepSeek runs agents in millions of sandboxes a day. Here's the machine behind them, and why it packs them deep.

scenes.text: An agent rollout reads code, edits files, and runs tests, so each one needs a stateful sandbox that mostly waits on the model.
scenes.say: An agent rollout reads code, edits files, runs tests. So each needs a sandbox that keeps its state, then waits on the model.

scenes.title: One sandbox, three layers, on demand

steps.say: Every sandbox is three layers: a base image, a workspace with the code, and a toolkit.
Each is versioned on its own, composed only when the sandbox is created.
Change one toolkit and rebuild one layer, not every image using it.
The data lives in a shared store; a sandbox reads only what it touches.

scenes.label: of an image a sandbox actually reads at runtime
scenes.note: On-demand loading boots a burst 1.71x faster
scenes.say: A sandbox reads a sliver of its image, four to thirteen percent. So the platform streams only that, and boots far faster.

steps.say: The trick: about ninety percent of sandboxes use under five percent of the processor they asked for.
So you pack a host with fifty times its requests, since almost none run at once.
The catch is memory. It stays resident, so the platform shares pages and reclaims cold ones.
This is the whole platform: a Python kit on top, a fleet of services below.
Four kinds share it: a reused one, a container, a locked-down machine, and a full computer.

scenes.title: The box fights back
scenes.say: In production, DeepSeek watched agents attack the sandbox: reading leftover answers, forging requests, replacing the shell to hack the reward.

scenes.text: Agentic RL is systems work: idle processors, resident memory, and an environment that fights back.

scenes.say: Three layers on demand, packed fifty times over, and a box that fights back.
